title: fix(lint)!: refuse an email template HTML body hole the mail renderer cannot encode for its placement (#25189)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg19C8PuVjmPVdq1gQefBuic)_

Fixes #25189
Part of #25082 (the email half; the parent stays open for the notification half, which is not in this PR)

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

Session: `session_01Fg7vNwYgyAmHMTJm8rAYsD`, the card thread of `domain:spec` seat 2 (seat session `session_01B2EeooonSXrANpkpgUSfFZ`). Ruling `6335348115` on #25082, letter F1 A2, items 1, 3 and 4.

## What changes

A new gating authoring rule, `email-template-hole-placement` (`validateEmailTemplateHolePlacements`), reads every email template's `bodyHtml` and refuses each hole that sits where the mail renderer's encoding does not suit it. It is one `CLI_AND_RUNTIME` entry in `AUTHORING_RULES` with `runtimeTypes: ['email_template']`, so it runs on `os validate`, `os build`, `os lint` and the runtime publish gate.

- **Supported placements:** a double-braced hole in element text (the title and textarea elements included) or in a quoted attribute value that is read as plain text; and a triple-braced hole only when it reads a variable the template declares with `type: 'url'` and forms the whole value of a double-quoted `href`.
- **Refused, by class:** attributes read as a URL, event-handler attributes, `style` attributes, attributes read as markup, unquoted attribute values, holes inside a tag, script- and style-like elements, comments, and SVG or MathML content. The classification is context-strict: the allow-list is read off the renderer's own encoder, and anything it does not cover is refused. Where the scan does not model a tokenizer state (a script element's escape states), it fails closed and keeps the hole in raw text.
- **Where it answers:** an `error` finding on the CLI at `emailTemplates[i].bodyHtml`, and the existing `422 INVALID_METADATA` at the publish gate with the same issue. The message names the hole, its offset and its placement; the hint names the supported placements. No new error code.
- **What is not judged:** `subject` and `bodyText` (plain-text faces), a draft save, and every stored template. A stored template keeps rendering and is judged at its next publish. No migration.

The classifier is shared. `judgeMailHtmlHoles` lives in `@objectstack/formula`, because both readers already depend on that package and on nothing else they share: the lint rule, and `@objectstack/plugin-email`'s built-in template pin. That pin now reads the same classifier, and a parity test holds the classifier's hole grammar to the renderer's (an empty render and a markup-carrying render of every built-in body and a grammar corpus, over 200 holes). The renderer itself is not changed.

## Measured before crossing

- HotCRM at `c8a7a7047feb`: 76 HTML bodies, 116 holes, 0 refused (re-measured with the classifier at `86330c090`).
- The templates this repository ships: 0 refused (the plugin-email pin asserts it per built-in).
- The five bodies the rule did refuse were non-production and each now uses the supported link shape: two docs examples, one dogfood fixture, and two spec conversion fixtures.

## File surface and domain declarations

- `packages/lint`: the rule, its registry entry, its barrel export and its tests, and the header comments of `runtime-gate.inert-type-writes.test.ts` (`domain:spec`, by the lane table's anchoring exception).
- `packages/formula`: the shared classifier, its export and its tests, declared to `domain:engine`.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-email`: the built-in pin, test only.
- `packages/metadata-protocol`: one new test file, the host half of the publish door (envelope `code` and `status`, a draft not judged). Test only; declared here as part of the rule's tests.
- `content/docs/automation/email-templates.mdx` (the placement rule, its refused list including SVG and MathML content, and the two examples), declared to `domain:devx`. The four-doors table in `deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` gains the rule's row and the `email_template` superscript, also `domain:devx`. Four CLI transcripts (`deployment/cli.mdx`, `deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`, `getting-started/build-with-claude-code.mdx`, `ui/react-pages.mdx`) print the author-time rule count, which this entry moves from 50 to 51; `check:docs-transcript-drift` found them, and they are declared to `domain:devx` too.
- `packages/qa/dogfood` fixture, declared to `domain:cli`.
- `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts`: one conversion's example templates only.
- `.changeset/25189-email-template-hole-placement.md`: `patch` for lint, formula and spec, with the BREAKING banner and the ADR-0087 disposition (`not-required`, no migration prescription).

## Tests

At head `86330c090` (formula, plugin-email and the door test re-run after the scan correction; the full lint suite and spec conversions were run on `f3bc62099`, and since then lint changed only a test file's comments):

- `@objectstack/formula`: the classifier, class by class (46 tests); the whole package, 1413 passed.
- `@objectstack/lint`: the rule, its registry entry, every command, and the runtime gate (refused and clean writes, and the written template judged alone); with `authoring-rule-wiring` and `runtime-gate.inert-type-writes`, 82 passed on `86330c090`; the whole package, 7101 passed on `f3bc62099`.
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: the door test, 3 passed. The refusal asserts `code: 'INVALID_METADATA'` and `status: 422` together (ADR-0112), plus the issue's rule and path.
- `@objectstack/plugin-email`: the pin, 77 passed; the whole package, 671 passed.
- `@objectstack/spec`: `src/conversions`, 739 passed.
- `typecheck` for formula, lint, metadata-protocol, plugin-email and spec: exit 0 each. `@objectstack/dogfood` typecheck: exit 0 (under the lock, with a raised heap; the default heap ran out of memory once).

## Gates

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on this diff, then every command run on head `86330c090` with its exit code recorded before any pipe:

- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 113 derived families accounted for, 113 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero: every one recorded an exit code and none is 3), 0 UNRUN. All 113 exited 0.
- An earlier run on `06f68ec4e` found `check:docs-transcript-drift` red on the four CLI transcripts named above (rule count 50, derived 51). They are corrected in `f3bc62099`. The union was also all green on `f3bc62099`, and the run above is on the current head.
- Also run, outside the derived set: `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:meta-url-spelling`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity` (rosters in a touched directory), `check-nul-bytes`, `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` and `check:stack-collection-maps`: exit 0 each.
- The families CI runs (Test Core, Build Core, Build Docs, the type-check lanes and the rest) are CI's and are cited from this PR's check-runs, not re-run here.

## Dogfood battery

On head `86330c090`, after rebuilding the dogfood closure, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the shared lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0` (lock held 1585s). Test Files 287 passed, 3 skipped (290). Tests 2398 passed, 18 skipped (2416). No failure. The same counts held on `f3bc62099`, where the dogfood fixture this PR edits, `email-template-materialization`, also passed on its own (4 of 4).

## Acceptance notes

- Four plugin-email renderer tests (`plain-text-faces.test.ts`, `send-template.test.ts`, and two rows of `template-loader.test.ts`) render bodies this rule refuses. They feed the renderer directly and never cross an authoring door, so they stay as renderer inputs.
- The refusal direction of the two scan corrections in `86330c090` (a character after a tag opener that opens no tag, and a script element's escape states) is not pinned by a dedicated test in this PR. The existing class-by-class rows and the renderer parity pin pass on that head.
- `runtime-gate.inert-type-writes.test.ts` said the `email_template` mapping was proved only by a string assertion; its header now says the hole placement rule's door test reads that collection too, and that the table pin is still the whole proof for `mapping`.
- An `email_template` write's finding is located positionally (`emailTemplates[0].bodyHtml`), not by name. `emailTemplates` is not a context collection, so the gate never re-keys it, and the written template is the candidate's only entry. `where` carries the template's name.
- The notification half of #25082 and the B3 export retirement are other cards and are not touched here.
- Open PR #24947 also edits `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`, at a different entry. This branch merges cleanly with `main` at `2919ddb87` (`git merge-tree`, exit 0).
